title: RepForge assetManifest v17
description: Manifest of 3D exercise assets served from the R2 CDN (assets.repforge.app). Content-addressed object paths embed the first 12 hex chars of the GLB's SHA-256, so a given path is immutable forever. The Android client validates sha256 before caching an object (plan todo 27); the upload pipeline (plan todo 25) must emit manifests matching this schema.

manifestVersion.description: Schema version of this manifest document. Locked to 17.

generatedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of when the upload pipeline generated this manifest.

sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 digest (64 hex chars) of the GLB file bytes.

exerciseId.description: Stable snake_case exercise identifier, matching tools/exercise-assets/exercise_catalog.yaml keys.

glbPath.description: Content-addressed GLB path: /assets/exercises/<id>/movement.v<N>.<sha256-12>.glb where <sha256-12> is the first 12 hex chars of sha256 and <N> equals version. Cross-field consistency is enforced by validate_manifest.py.

thumb512Path.description: 512px WebP list thumbnail: /assets/exercises/<id>/thumb512.v<N>.<hash12>.webp (hash12 is the thumb file's own digest prefix; may differ from the GLB hash).

heroPath.description: 768-1024px WebP hero image: /assets/exercises/<id>/hero.v<N>.<hash12>.webp (hash12 is the hero file's own digest prefix; may differ from the GLB hash).

sizeBytes.description: Size of the GLB file in bytes.

version.description: Monotonic per-exercise asset version; increments on every re-export. Must equal the v<N> segment embedded in each path.

draco.description: True when the GLB uses Draco geometry compression (client must init the Draco decoder before loading).
